title: ship-sop configuration
description: Per-project configuration for ship-sop auto-mode and per-agent toggles.

mode.description: auto = SessionStop hook fires the pipeline; manual = /ship only; off = pipeline disabled entirely

min_diff_lines.description: Skip auto-fire if diff is smaller than this many lines

skip_docs_only.description: Accepted for older configs; no longer read by the trigger. Since 2026-09-04 (agent-sop P102) the automatic gate always excludes documentation extensions from the line count and fires only on code projects.

cooldown_seconds.description: Deprecated, unread: belonged to the retired project-scope hook; agent-sop's trigger throttles by commit state.

skip_branch_patterns.description: Regex patterns; auto-fire skips branches matching any of these

agents.description: Per-agent toggles. Keys are agent names; values control whether the gate runs and what severity blocks ship.

enabled.description: If false, the gate is skipped

block_on.description: Severity that hard-blocks ship. 'never' makes the gate advisory.

auto_file_backlog.description: Deprecated, unread: findings are never auto-filed to Backlog.md (operator rule); the session writes the report and the operator decides.

auto_publish.description: Deprecated, unread by the trigger; /release asks before publishing regardless.

default_branch.description: Deprecated, unread: the trigger detects the default branch from origin/HEAD.

version_source.description: Deprecated, unread by the trigger; /release detects the manifest.

artifacts.description: Optional housekeeping for files written under docs/reviews/.

retain_ship_artifact_days.description: Deprecated, unread: pruning belonged to the retired project-scope hook.
